how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CUTN JRF/Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JRF/Project Fellow position at CUTN?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the JRF/Project Fellow position at Central University of Tamil Nadu is 11 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF/Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Physics to be eligible for the JRF/Project Fellow position at CUTN.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the JRF/Project Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF/Project Fellow position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 28,000.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the CUTN JRF/Project Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email with all required documents. Ensure to send your application before the specified last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the JRF/Project Fellow position announced by the Central University of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF/Project Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF/Project Fellow role at CUTN will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The JRF/Project Fellow position at CUTN is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Central University of Tamil Nadu located?
faq.answer: The Central University of Tamil Nadu is located in Thiruvarur, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 610005.

faq.question: Q10. Does the notification mention any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such information.
